15769-in-the-wars-of-the-roses-a-story-f.title: A Story for the Young
15769-in-the-wars-of-the-roses-a-story-f.creator: Everett Evelyn-Green.
15769-in-the-wars-of-the-roses-a-story-f.description: A book by Everett Evelyn-Green.. nd over the floating curls of the gallant boy beside her; He was indeed a child of whom any mother might be proud: beautiful, straight-limbed, active, and fearless, his blue eyes glowing and shining, his cheek flushed with excitement, every look and gesture seeming to speak of the bold soldier spirit that burned within.

19421-the-french-revolution-a-short-hist.title: Copyright, 1909
19421-the-french-revolution-a-short-hist.creator: Unknown
19421-the-french-revolution-a-short-hist.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The magnitude of an event is too apt to lie with its reporter, and the reporter often fails in his sense of historical proportion. The nearer he is to the event the more authority he has as a witness, but the less authority as a judge. It is time alone can establish the relation and harmony of things.

arxiv-1909-06685.title: Automated Multiclass Cardiac Volume Segmentation and Model Generation
arxiv-1909-06685.creator: Erik Gaasedelen, Alex J. Deakyne, Paul A. Iaizzo
arxiv-1909-06685.description: Abstract Many strides have been made in semantic segmentation of multiple classes within an image. This has been largely due to advancements in deep learning and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Features within a CNN are automatically learned during training, which allows for the abstraction of semantic information within the images.

arxiv-2108-11678.title: On L p L^{p} Liouville theorems for Dirichlet forms
arxiv-2108-11678.creator: Bobo Hua, Matthias Keller, Daniel Lenz, Marcel Schmidt
arxiv-2108-11678.description: Abstract . We study harmonic functions for general Dirichlet forms. First we review consequences of Fukushima’s ergodic theorem for the harmonic functions in the domain of the L p L^{p} generator. Secondly we prove analogues of Yau’s and Karp’s Liouville theorems for weakly harmonic functions.

arxiv-2110-06541.title: Collaborative Radio SLAM for Multiple Robots based on WiFi Fingerprint Similarity Thanks: R. Liu, B. P. L. Lau, K. Ismail, A. Athukorala, C. Yuen, and U-X. Tan are with the Engineering Product Development Pillar, Singapore University of Technology and Design, 8 Somapah Rd, Singapore, 487372. { ran_l
arxiv-2110-06541.creator: Ran Liu, Zhenghong Qin, Hua Zhang, Billy Pik Lik Lau, Khairuldanial Ismail
arxiv-2110-06541.description: Abstract Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) enables autonomous robots to navigate and execute their tasks through unknown environments. However, performing SLAM in large environments with a single robot is not efficient, and visual or LiDAR-based SLAM requires feature extraction and matching algorithms, which are computationally expensive.

arxiv-2110-13495.title: Assessing the Sufficiency of Arguments through Conclusion Generation
arxiv-2110-13495.creator: Timon Gurcke, Milad Alshomary, Henning Wachsmuth
arxiv-2110-13495.description: Abstract The premises of an argument give evidence or other reasons to support a conclusion. However, the amount of support required depends on the generality of a conclusion, the nature of the individual premises, and similar. An argument whose premises make its conclusion rationally worthy to be drawn is called sufficient in argument quality research.

arxiv-2206-05645.title: True gravitational atom: Spherical cloud of dilatonic black holes
arxiv-2206-05645.creator: Yang Huang 1, Hongsheng Zhang 1
arxiv-2206-05645.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yang Huang 1, Hongsheng Zhang 1. Black hole as elementary particle is a fairly glamorous idea. For ordinary black holes, a surrounding particle inevitably penetrates into the interior of the hole since the center of the hole is an infinite potential well. For the first time we demonstrate that an extreme dilatonic black hole in spherical symmetry perfectly behaves as an atom, in the sense that its surrounding cloud of particles are completely stable. Thus we reach a spherical cloud of dilatonic black hole.

arxiv-2301-01926.title: Auditing citation polarization during the early COVID-19 pandemic
arxiv-2301-01926.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . The recent pandemic stimulated scientists to publish a significant amount of research that created a surge of citations of COVID-19-related publications in a short time, leading to an abrupt inflation of the journal impact factor (IF).

arxiv-2308-05523.title: Efficient detection of multidimensional single-photon time-bin superpositions
arxiv-2308-05523.creator: Adam Widomski, Maciej Ogrodnik, Michał Karpiński
arxiv-2308-05523.description: Abstract The ability to detect quantum superpositions lies at the heart of fundamental and applied aspects of quantum mechanics. The time-frequency degree of freedom of light enables encoding and transmitting quantum information in a multi-dimensional fashion compatible with fiber and integrated platforms. However, the ability to efficiently detect time-frequency superpositions is not yet available.

arxiv-2311-14574.title: Two Galois connections for left quasigroups
arxiv-2311-14574.creator: Marco Bonatto
arxiv-2311-14574.description: Abstract . We investigate two Galois connection between the congruence lattice and the lattice of subgroups of the displacement group of left quasigroups. Such connections were already studied for racks and quandles. We introduce the class of left quasigroups having congruence determined by subgroups (resp. orbits) and we extend a known result for quandles.

arxiv-2405-01859.title: AI-Powered Autonomous Weapons Risk Geopolitical Instability and Threaten AI Research
arxiv-2405-01859.creator: Riley Simmons-Edler, Ryan P. Badman, Shayne Longpre, Kanaka Rajan
arxiv-2405-01859.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Riley Simmons-Edler, Ryan P. Badman, Shayne Longpre, Kanaka Rajan. The recent embrace of machine learning (ML) in the development of autonomous weapons systems (AWS) creates serious risks to geopolitical stability and the free exchange of ideas in AI research. This topic has received comparatively little attention of late compared to risks stemming from superintelligent artificial general intelligence (AGI), but requires fewer assumptions about the course of technological development and is thus a nearer-future issue.

arxiv-2508-18549.title: COMET-poly: Machine Translation Metric Grounded in Other Candidates
arxiv-2508-18549.creator: Maike Züfle, Vilém Zouhar, Tu Anh Dinh, Felipe Maia Polo, Jan Niehues, Mrinmaya Sachan, [0.7em] Karlsruhe Institute of Technology
arxiv-2508-18549.description: Abstract Automated metrics for machine translation attempt to replicate human judgment. Unlike humans, who often assess a translation in the context of multiple alternatives, these metrics typically consider only the source sentence and a single translation. This discrepancy in the evaluation setup may negatively impact the performance of automated metrics.

arxiv-2511-08933.title: Continuum variability in multi-epoch quasar spectra from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey
arxiv-2511-08933.creator: Minjin Kim, Suyeon Son, Luis C. Ho
arxiv-2511-08933.description: Abstract We examine the continuum variability of active galactic nuclei (AGNs) by analyzing the multi-epoch spectroscopic data from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey. To achieve this, we utilized approximately 2 million spectroscopy pairwise combinations observed across different epochs for ∼ 90,000 \sim 90,000 AGNs.

plos-pone-0357272.title: Autonomous emergency braking optimal coordination control strategy for commercial buses considering safety and comfort
plos-pone-0357272.creator: Shoulin Gao, Xingyu Liu, Jianlong Hu, Chaohui Yang, Zewen Yang, Kai Jiang
plos-pone-0357272.description: Autonomous emergency braking optimal coordination control strategy for commercial buses considering safety and comfort

pmc-10741446.title: Early Communicative Development in Williams Syndrome: A Longitudinal Case Study
pmc-10741446.creator: Eliseo Diez-Itza, Florencia Llona, Verónica Martínez
pmc-10741446.description: Individuals with Williams Syndrome (WS) have a specific and atypical neuropsychological profile, where language is above what is expected for their mental age, although it shows a late onset. There exists only one longitudinal study in infants younger than 20 months old with WS about early language precursors (joint attention, referential and instrumental behaviors, pointing gesture, verbal tags).

pmc-11313400.title: Insulin–Heart Axis: Bridging Physiology to Insulin Resistance
pmc-11313400.creator: Alfredo Caturano, Raffaele Galiero, Erica Vetrano, Celestino Sardu, Luca Rinaldi, Vincenzo Russo, Marcellino Monda, Raffaele Marfella, Ferdinando Carlo Sasso
pmc-11313400.description: Insulin signaling is vital for regulating cellular metabolism, growth, and survival pathways, particularly in tissues such as adipose, skeletal muscle, liver, and brain. Its role in the heart, however, is less well-explored. The heart, requiring significant ATP to fuel its contractile machinery, relies on insulin signaling to manage myocardial substrate supply and directly affect cardiac muscle metabolism.

pmc-11402249.title: Intrafamilial phenotypic variability due to a missense pathogenic variant in FBP1 gene
pmc-11402249.creator: Setila Dalili, Nasrin Sedighi Pirsaraei, Ameneh Sharifi, Alireza Pouryousef, Fatemeh Aghaee, Reza Bayat, Babak Ghavami, Bahareh Rabbani, Nejat Mahdieh
pmc-11402249.description: BackgroundFBPase deficiency as an autosomal recessive disorder is due pathogenic variants in the FBP1 gene. It usually presents with hyperlactic acidemia and hypoglycaemia starting from early childhood. Here, genotypes and phenotypes of all reported patients and their distributions are presented.

pmc-11604928.title: Research on multi-objective optimization method of Z-shaped pipeline structure based on Kriging model
pmc-11604928.creator: Chunya Sun, Zhengdong Xiao, Yanqiu Xiao, Zhifang Xu, Wanbin Cui, Pengpeng Wang, Zhanpeng Fang, Guangzhen Cui, Lianhui Jia
pmc-11604928.description: Slurry pipeline transportation is widely used in dredging and serves as an essential method for conveying solid materials. However, accurately describing the interaction between slurry and particles through numerical simulations, while optimizing the pipeline structure to improve the performance of slurry pipelines, poses a significant engineering challenge.

pmc-12428097.title: Targeting Oncogenic Activity and Signalling of Mutant Receptor Tyrosine Kinase FLT3
pmc-12428097.creator: Boban Dobrevski, Hannah Willems, Carolin Lossius-Cott, Jörg P. Müller
pmc-12428097.description: Simple SummaryFms-like tyrosine kinase 3 (FLT3) is a receptor protein kinase that channels haematologic cell differentiation. Its gene is frequently mutated in acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) patients. One common mutation, FLT3 ITD, results in a constitutive active kinase, which promotes oncogenic cell proliferation and blocks cell differentiation. The occurrence of FLT3 ITD mutations is linked to worse outcomes.

pmc-12457305.title: Development and validation of a nomogram to predict the risk of type II endoleak after endovascular aneurysm repair
pmc-12457305.creator: Bowen Liu, Xiaobin Tang, Nan He, Zhong Chen
pmc-12457305.description: ObjectiveType II endoleak (T2EL) is the most common complication following endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) of abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA). T2EL may lead to aneurysm sac expansion and rupture. Identifying high-risk patients is crucial for prophylaxis and early intervention.MethodsThis single-center retrospective study included 332 patients who underwent EVAR for infrarenal AAA. Demographic, clinical, anatomical, and medication-related data were collected.

pmc-12586201.title: Endoscopic papillectomy for ampullary adenomas in familial adenomatous polyposis
pmc-12586201.creator: C Wehling, Y Eckstein, A Stenzinger, N Ganion, T Bruckner, P Sauer, C C Zhang-Hagenlocher, M Kantowski, R Koschny
pmc-12586201.description: Objectives of the study were to determine the success, complication and recurrence rate of endoscopic papillectomies in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) patients. Ampullary adenoma is frequent in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) patients. Endoscopic papillectomy is technically demanding for laterally spreading ampullary adenomas and bleeding, perforation and pancreatitis represent typical complications. 40 FAP patients undergoing endoscopic papillectomy were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-12985288.title: Serum Dkk-1 Is Associated with Pain Intensity, Flare-Ups, and Bone Mineral Density in Non-Obese Patients with Knee Osteoarthritis: A Single-Center, Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12985288.creator: Timea-Csilla Nagy-Finna, Árpád Sólyom, János Székely, Pál-István Kikeli, Erika-Lídia Szövérfi, Hunor Lukács, Anna-Lilla Faragó, Emőke Horváth, Horațiu Popoviciu, Előd Ernő Nagy
pmc-12985288.description: Osteoarthritis is the most common musculoskeletal disorder. It primarily affects people in their mid-40s and older. As the disease progresses, degenerative changes occur in the synovial membrane, subchondral bone, and cartilage. Ultimately, the entire joint and its surrounding tissues become structurally and functionally impaired. Several sets of biochemical markers have been proposed to enable timely diagnosis and anticipate disease progression.

pmc-13200100.title: Integrated Hemodynamic Measures of Cardiac Function and Association With Clinical Outcomes
pmc-13200100.creator: Omar K Trad, Juhi K Parekh, Leah B Kosyakovsky, Louisa Mounsey, Eugene V Pomerantsev, Michael H Picard, Pablo A Quintero Pinzon, Marwa Sabe, E Wilson Grandin, Arthur R Garan, Jennifer E Ho
pmc-13200100.description: BackgroundAortic pulsatility index (API) and cardiac power output (CPO) are strongly associated with mortality in patients with cardiogenic shock, but their association with outcomes across broader cardiopulmonary disease is unknown.ObjectivesThe objective of the study was to examine the association of API and CPO with clinical outcomes across a hospital-based cardiovascular cohort.
